text: The second season of The Circle premiered on April 14, 2021, and concluded on May 5, 2021, following its announcement in March 2020 when Netflix renewed the series for a second and third season. Michelle Buteau returned as host. Players compete to become the most popular without meeting face-to-face; instead, they communicate through a custom social media app where they can portray themselves in any way they choose, a practice known as catfishing. The first eight players were revealed on April 5, 2021, with additional contestants added during the season. On May 5, 2021, DeLeesa St. Agathe won the season by playing as her husband, Trevor, and received the US$100,000 prize, while Chloe Veitch finished as runner-up and won the Fan Favorite award along with US$10,000. All players live in separate apartments within the same building and communicate exclusively through the app. Players rate each other from first to last, and at the end of each round, their average ratings are shared from lowest to highest. Typically, the two highest-rated players become Influencers, while others are at risk of being Blocked by the Influencers. However, twists may occur, such as instant blocking of the lowest-rated players, secret Influencers, or multiple blocks. Blocked players are eliminated but get to meet one remaining player in person, with a video message revealing whether they were real or fake the day after. In the finale, the highest-rated player wins US$100,000, and fans vote for their favorite player, who earns US$10,000 as Fan Favorite. The initial players introduced were Bryant, Savannah, Chloe, Courtney, "Trevor"/DeLeesa, "Emily"/Jack, "River"/Lee, and Terilisha. Suspicion arises when "Trevor," a single dad, is revealed to be played by DeLeesa, who is 32 years old. Bryant begins a private chat with Courtney, offering support, while Jack, playing a 21-year-old sorority girl named Emily, starts a group chat with the girls. Savannah and Terilisha are named Influencers and are given 24 hours to decide who to save from elimination. They choose to save "Emily"/Jack and "Trevor"/DeLeesa. The other players begin conversations with the Influencers. Bryant convinces Terilisha not to eliminate him, which succeeds. Courtney forms an alliance with Savannah, and Chloe and "Trevor"/DeLeesa flirt. Savannah wants to block "River"/Lee, but Terilisha opposes it. Ultimately, Bryant is voted off and chooses to meet "River"/Lee in person before leaving. After the season, the Circle announces a new player joining. A video reveals Bryant is not a catfish. New player Lisa joins as "Lance," a former NSYNC member. Skepticism grows after "Lance"’s identity is revealed. Savannah accidentally reveals Terilisha attempted to block Courtney, leading to an alliance. Terilisha starts a group chat with Chloe and "Emily"/Jack, expressing suspicions about Savannah. Terilisha accuses Savannah of being a game player, and Savannah accuses Terilisha of being untrustworthy. "Trevor"/DeLeesa reaches out to Savannah after the conflict, offering support. Terilisha warns Courtney that Savannah is causing drama, which Courtney believes is due to Terilisha. Savannah reaches out to Chloe and "Emily"/Jack for support. Savannah’s video reveals she is not a catfish and states there are still multiple catfish in the game. Courtney is in the Inner Circle and unlocks a secret identity, "The Joker," who speaks to new players, Mitchell and Khat, before they join. Courtney warns them not to trust Chloe or Terilisha. Courtney returns to the Inner Circle and selects one player to become an influencer at the next blocking. Chloe flirts with both Mitchell and "Trevor"/DeLeesa. "River"/Lee is chosen as the influencer. The players are told one of them was a catfish but not who. Terilisha talks to Khat to learn what "The Joker" said and assumes it was "Emily"/Jack. The ratings reveal Courtney as the second influencer. Terilisha is blocked and meets Chloe. Her video reveals she knows who "The Joker" is and what was said to Khat and Mitchell. Khat, "Lance"/Lisa, and Mitchell discuss and believe "Lance"/Lisa is a catfish. Mitchell friend zones Chloe after "Trevor"/DeLeesa tells him they are close. "Emily"/Jack is upset, believing the game cost him and that everyone thinks he is catfishing. The players receive an alert that two players will be blocked the next day. "Emily"/Jack and "Lance"/Lisa form a friendship. Khat and "Trevor"/DeLeesa discuss their suspicions with "Emily"/Jack and "Lance"/Lisa. Chloe, Courtney, and "River"/Lee discuss their suspicions with "Emily"/Jack. "Trevor"/DeLeesa suspects "River"/Lee of sending a catfish message about her. The ratings show no influencers, and "Emily"/Jack and "Lance"/Lisa are instantly blocked. "Lance"/Lisa chooses to meet "River"/Lee, and "Emily"/Jack chooses "Trevor"/DeLeesa. They meet and receive a second chance with a shared profile set up by The Circle. Jack and Lisa now play as "John," a 64-year-old psychic. Their videos are posted, revealing both were catfishing. The Circle chat opens, and players are unaware that "John"/Jack and Lisa are lurking. No one confirms if "Emily"/Jack or "Lance"/Lisa visited them after being blocked, leading to suspicion. The "John"/Jack and Lisa profile is revealed. Khat tells Courtney and "River"/Lee that she believes Chloe is a liar and unaware they are both close to her. Chloe starts a chat with "Trevor"/DeLeesa and admits her feelings. "Trevor"/DeLeesa continues to flirt despite knowing she is catfishing. Courtney and "River"/Lee inform Chloe about Khat’s claims. Chloe says she thinks Khat is a game player. Courtney informs "Trevor"/DeLeesa about Khat’s feelings toward Chloe. The players rate each other, and the ratings reveal Chloe and "Trevor"/DeLeesa as the influencers. Khat is blocked and meets "Trevor"/DeLeesa. Her video shows she was not a catfish and advises players not to believe everything. Courtney and "River"/Lee decide to monitor Mitchell, who hasn’t spoken to either of them. Mitchell and "Trevor"/DeLeesa plan to break up Courtney and "River"/Lee’s alliance. "Trevor"/DeLeesa begins by talking to "River"/Lee. Mitchell talks to Chloe to join his alliance. The players receive an alert that the final blocking occurs the next day. Mitchell’s video is posted. Final ratings are submitted. Players get to meet face-to-face. Chloe meets "Trevor"/DeLeesa and sees she was catfishing. "River"/Lee is revealed as a catfish to Chloe, Courtney, and "Trevor"/DeLeesa. "John"/Jack and Lisa are revealed as catfish to the remaining finalists.
